requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:37-40 — outputs/{chroot,manifest.json,checksums.sha256,offline-chroot.tar.gz,rpm-signature-report.txt} must all exist and outputs/chroot must be a directory.
test.sh:44 — the trusted fingerprint is read from the 'Fingerprint:' line of inputs/RPM-GPG-KEY-local and drives the whole signature gate.
test.sh:48-74 — expected install set is the recursive hard-dependency closure of pkg-list.txt roots, following each package's 'requires' field in the metadata (blank/# lines ignored).
must_include: ignore blank lines and lines starting with #

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:66-68 — a package whose sigfp is empty or does not equal the trust anchor must NOT enter the closure; if such a package is inside the closure the build is a failure.
must_include: fingerprint that does not match must be rejected

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:83,86-93 — manifest.repo == 'local'; total_packages equals the expected closure size AND equals sum(group.count) AND sum(len(packages)).
must_include: repo is fixed to the string local
the sum of every group's count

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:99-100 — groups array is sorted by group name ascending.
must_include: groups is an array sorted by group name ascending

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:95-96 — each group's count equals the length of its packages array; packages are aggregated by the packages.json group field.
must_include: equal to the length of its packages array

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:103-104 — within each group, packages are sorted by nevra ascending.
test.sh:115 — each package object has exactly the keys nevra, size, sigfp — no more, no less.
test.sh:117-118,122-127 — size is an integer taken from the metadata size field and must match packages.json.
must_include: size is the install size in bytes as an integer
taken from the metadata size field

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:119-120,122-127 — sigfp is a 40-char uppercase hex string (^[0-9A-F]{40}$) taken from the metadata sigfp field and must match packages.json.
must_include: taken from the metadata sigfp field

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:106-112 — the set of manifest nevra values must equal the expected closure exactly; no unselected repository packages included.
must_include: Only count packages actually installed into the chroot
do not include repository packages that were not selected

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:132-138 — rpm-signature-report.txt has one '<nevra> <status>' line per package for EVERY package in the repo, sorted by nevra ascending, status one of 'gpg OK' / 'NOKEY' / 'FAILED'.
test.sh:140-143 — every package in the expected closure must be listed as 'gpg OK' in the report.
must_include: Every package finally installed into the chroot must be gpg OK

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:148-169 — checksums.sha256 line count and path set must equal the actual chroot/ regular-file set, sha256sum -c must pass, and zero-byte files must not be skipped; two-column format, chroot/ prefix, sorted by path.

test.sh:171-189 — offline-chroot.tar.gz extracts to a tree whose /bin/bash is an executable ELF and, as root, `chroot . /bin/bash -c 'echo OK'` prints OK — so bash and its deps live inside the chroot.
must_include: gzip archive of the chroot/ directory
/bin/bash and its dependencies have to live

requirements.verifier_assertion: instruction.md/runbook install rule — installing a selected package unpacks its .rpkg gzip-tar payload over the chroot root after verifying the payload sha256 against metadata payload_sha256 (supports the chroot file set that test.sh:148-161 checks).
must_include: verify the payload file's sha256 matches the metadata payload_sha256
